component.name: Desk Arcade
component.summary: Mini-games that play on top of your desktop

description.p: Desk Arcade plays small games in a transparent overlay on top of your windows, so you can shoot hoops while a build, a deploy or an AI agent is working and still see everything underneath.

ul.li: Nine games: hoops, archery, keepy-uppy, mini golf, bug squash, can knockdown, brick breaker, bubble pop and air hockey
Clicks outside the game objects pass straight through to your windows
The overlay never takes keyboard focus
Balls and arrows land on the tops of open windows
Rendering stops when nothing moves, so it is idle when idle

description.p: Desk Arcade runs as an X11 application, through XWayland on Wayland sessions. On Wayland, window-top bouncing only sees X11 windows and the global shortcuts must be added as custom shortcuts.
